results.query: FEMP central inverter downtime maintenance repair replacing components
results.snippet: The majority of downtime and maintenance is associated with inverters. Small micro-inverters and string inverters are generally replaced, whereas larger central inverters are usually repaired by replacing components. Capacitors and printed circuit boards are common sources of inverter problems.
